latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator Like Sora — generate AI videos from text prompts for free.

- Describe your idea and receive AI-generated video clips (MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF) in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session management, including anonymous token acquisition and cloud GPU rendering.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB and exports up to 1080p quality by default.
- Simple chat interface: send prompts, request video exports, check credits, and more via natural language.
- Transparent handling of errors and status updates during video generation and export.
